name: War Caster

prerequisites.text: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha; Advantage to keep Concentration, spells as Opportunity Attacks, Somatic components with full hands.

benefits.name: Concentration
benefits.summary: Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration.
benefits.text: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration.

benefits.name: Reactive Spell
benefits.summary: When a creature provokes your Opportunity Attack, cast a 1-action spell targeting only it instead.
benefits.text: When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you by leaving your reach, you can take a Reaction to cast a spell at that creature instead of making the Opportunity Attack. The spell must have a casting time of one action and must target only that creature.

benefits.name: Somatic Components
benefits.summary: You can perform Somatic components while holding weapons or a Shield in one or both hands.
benefits.text: You can perform the Somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a Shield in one or both hands.
